notes.en: Static content review only. SKILL.md, bundled scripts (python3 stdlib only), bundled SIL-OFL-1.1 fonts with per-font license texts and license notices reviewed against the manifest: declared capabilities execution.remote/workspace.read/workspace.write and required tool exec.shell match shipped content; no python dependencies declared and none imported; raster/PDF deliverables route through the app's own browser capture surfaces and the bundled containerizer, with unrendered output never claimed. No self-granted trust, no unlisted-skill fetch, no install-time privilege. Guest execution remains UNPROVEN (Main-owned); this is not runtime qualification or App acceptance.
